description: Take back the last publish at once: restores the previous version of the pages it changed and publishes them; the undone changes stay as unpublished changes (`restaged`). On a live-mode site nothing is kept (its next save would republish it): the answer has `redo.version` — restore_version with it and publish: true brings it back. publishVersion = what publish_site returned. not_latest if another publish landed since. If its publish fails, the undo stays unpublished — publish_site finishes it.

publishVersion.description: The version the publish to undo returned.

name: undo_publish
